curiosities: Its custom chips were nicknamed Agnus, Denise and Paula.
It was the best-selling Amiga, with the whole computer inside its keyboard.
Without a disk, early models showed a hand holding a floppy, asking for a Workbench disk.
Its processor is a Motorola 68000 at about 7 MHz.
It has 512 KB of memory; a slot under a trapdoor takes another 512 KB.
Its HAM mode shows all 4,096 of its colours at once.
Its floppy drive fits 880 KB on a double-density disk.
Its custom chips came from Jay Miner's team at Amiga Corporation, which Commodore bought in 1984.
Ultimate Soundtracker of 1987 began the MOD music format, the start of tracker music.
Lemmings, Shadow of the Beast and Sensible Soccer are among its best-known games.
The Amiga 500 Plus of 1991 came with Kickstart 2.0.
